info.title: STAS Intervals Gateway
info.description: Gateway for Intervals.icu planned workouts (read/write/delete) + STAS DB endpoints. Auth via OAuth2.

get.summary: Get current user identity from JWT token
Get detailed package for one completed training
get.description: Read-only detailed package for one selected completed workout. Use after getTrainings identifies the exact training_id. Do not batch this action across many workouts. The response omits rawData, route coordinates, latlng, and raw stream arrays.

parameters.name: training_id
parameters.description: Training id returned by trainings actions. Load trainings first to identify the exact completed workout.

200.description: Detailed activity package for one selected workout

404.description: Training not found for current user

get.description: Read current rules and profile memory with hashes. Goals and results are available only through getEditableGoalsResults.

post.description: Preview one rules/profile memory change. Identical normalized text returns noChange=true and creates no history record. Goals and results use previewGoalResultChange.

403.description: Write disabled, section disabled, not allowlisted, or sensitive data rejected

409.description: Current section text differs from previousHash

post.description: Save a previewed rules/profile change. Goals and results use commitGoalResultChange.

get.description: Read a compact paginated history index. Full texts and hashes are omitted; use readProfileChangeDetail for one selected record.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page.

post.description: Restore one committed change only after readProfileChangeDetail and explicit confirmation of the exact previous text.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: Committed profile memory change id.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Return planned events for last N days window (relative). If omitted, can use oldest/newest.

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Oldest date (YYYY-MM-DD) inclusive.

parameters.name: newest
parameters.description: Newest date (YYYY-MM-DD) inclusive.

delete.summary: Delete planned workouts by exact id, exact external_id, or external_id_prefix + date window (supports dry_run)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact Intervals event id to delete. Safest selector for one known event, e.g. 116577024. Can be comma-separated for multiple exact ids.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Exact external_id to delete, e.g. test:write-check:2026-06-18. Can be comma-separated or repeated as external_ids.

parameters.name: external_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact external_id values to delete. Use only when every value is known exactly.

parameters.name: external_id_prefix
parameters.description: Delete only events whose external_id starts with this prefix, e.g. plan: or test:. Requires oldest and newest. Gateway re-filters by external_id prefix before deleting.

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Oldest date (YYYY-MM-DD) inclusive. Required with external_id_prefix; optional narrowing window with external_id.

parameters.name: newest
parameters.description: Newest date (YYYY-MM-DD) inclusive. Required with external_id_prefix; optional narrowing window with external_id.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, do not delete, only report what would be deleted. Always use dry_run first before deleting by prefix.

delete.description: Safe delete selector. Prefer exact id, or exact external_id. Use external_id_prefix only with oldest/newest for confirmed window replacement. Gateway re-filters by external_id before dry-run and real delete.

post.description: Bulk create planned events via Intervals API (dedupe by external_id).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Required. false writes to Intervals.icu; true validates/previews only without creating events.

get.summary: Get a bounded completed-workout list from STAS
get.description: Size-safe workout list. Omit full for chronology, load, reports, and choosing training_id. Use full=true only to compare multiple workouts in a bounded date range. For one workout, call getActivityDetailFromDB. Check listDetail for omitted or truncated sections.

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Start boundary date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

parameters.name: newest
parameters.description: End boundary date (YYYY-MM-DD). For calendar windows, use the day after the last desired date.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Relative days window. Prefer oldest/newest for planning history.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max trainings per page. Real cap is 50.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset when a date window needs more pages.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Optional analysis-rich list mode for comparing multiple workouts. It is still compact and size-safe, not raw data and not the detailed view for one workout. Omit it for listing/lookup; use getActivityDetailFromDB after selecting one exact training_id.

200.description: Bounded completed-workout list with per-item listDetail accounting

502.description: Upstream error, auth error, or invalid upstream response

get.summary: Get full user summary via gateway in up to two parts
get.description: Call part 1. On partial, call part 2 with expectedVersion, merge the top-level data, and only then answer. On version_mismatch restart. Use summaryFreshness: stale or refresh_failed means not verified current; null means unavailable, not zero. Make at most two calls per summaryVersion.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: Optional part number. Omit this parameter or use 1 for the first call; use 2 only after a partial response.

parameters.name: expectedVersion
parameters.description: Required when part=2. Use the summaryVersion returned by the first partial response.

200.description: Complete summary or one part of a two-part summary

404.description: Small error response when the summary is unavailable

409.description: The summary version changed; restart with part=1

413.description: The summary cannot fit into two parts

get.summary: Read editable goals, starts, and results
get.description: Read the authoritative current state before any goals/results change. Keep dataVersion and use it in previewGoalResultChange. This does not write anything.

get.summary: Read eligible activities for one start
get.description: Read exact activity candidates before linking a completed start to an activity. Use only an event goal public ID from getEditableGoalsResults.

parameters.name: goal_id
parameters.description: Event goal public ID.

post.summary: Preview one exact goals or results change
post.description: Required write gate: first read getEditableGoalsResults, then preview one exact change with that dataVersion. Show the returned before/after/effects and request explicit confirmation. This does not save anything.

post.summary: Commit a confirmed goals or results change
post.description: Commit only the exact preview after the user explicitly confirms its before/after/effects. Then use returned state as the source of truth; calendar synchronization may still be pending.

get.summary: Read one profile change in full
get.description: Load exact old/new text and hashes for one record selected from readProfileChangeHistory. This is read-only.

user_id.description: Intervals athlete id resolved from OAuth token

section.description: Choose profile for athlete facts, goals for targets, rules for constraints. Do not mix sections.

structured.description: Rules/profile input only. Goals and results use the dedicated goals-results operations.

previousHash.description: Hash returned by readProfileSections for this section.

diffSummary.description: Short factual summary of what changed. Do not include raw chat.

birthYear.description: Birth year. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

gender.description: Gender from the web profile form. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

height.description: Height in cm. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

weight.description: Weight in kg. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

maxHr.description: Maximum heart rate. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

ltHr.description: Lactate-threshold heart rate. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

otherSports.description: Other sports. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

raceResults.description: Race PR list. If provided, replaces the whole list; [] or null clears it. Omit to preserve.

additional.description: Additional durable profile context. Do not use for firstName.

trainingsPerWeek.description: Exact single number for Тренировок в неделю. Do not send ranges, minimums, maximums, or flexible wording here.

offDays.description: Exact single number for Выходных. Do not send ranges, minimums, maximums, or flexible wording here.

restDays.description: Fixed rest weekdays for Дни отдыха, only when the user names fixed weekdays.

customRules.description: Separate durable custom rules. The server writes one Правило line per item.

changeId.description: Preview change id returned by previewProfileSectionChange.

newText.description: Server-rendered exact full text proposed or committed by the change. Do not send newText in preview requests.

start_date_local.description: Local start datetime without timezone suffix, e.g. 2026-02-16T09:00:00

end_date_local.description: Local end datetime without timezone suffix. For NOTE all-day: next day T00:00:00

category.description: WORKOUT for training, NOTE for context/rest/illness. Defaults to WORKOUT if omitted.

type.description: Title Case activity type. Required for WORKOUT. Omit for NOTE.

description.description: Structured multi-line description. For structured workouts, use native Intervals.icu workout text lines, for example '- 10m Z2 HR'. HR-only workouts must use HR targets such as Z2 HR, not pace or power.

moving_time.description: Duration in seconds. For WORKOUT only, omit for NOTE.

icu_training_load.description: Estimated training load. For WORKOUT only, omit for NOTE. Intervals.icu may store load but return icu_atl/icu_ctl as null or exclude/partially weight non-cardio/support types in Fitness/Fatigue depending on athlete settings.

external_id.description: Stable unique ID for upsert/update, e.g. plan:2026-03-11:easy-run or note:2026-03-11:illness. Reuse the same value when editing an existing event.

for_week.description: For NOTE only: mark the note as applying to the whole week.

target.description: Optional Intervals workout target. Use HR for heart-rate-only structured workouts, PACE for pace-led run workouts, and POWER for power-led workouts. If omitted, STAS infers it from description when possible.

listDetail.description: Exact accounting for the size-safe list projection. If a section is truncated and exact execution matters, call getActivityDetailFromDB for this training id.

ActivityDetailResponse.description: AI-ready detailed passport for one completed workout. Raw source payloads, route coordinates, latlng, and raw stream arrays are intentionally omitted.

redactions.description: Confirms that raw source payloads, raw streams, route coordinates, and latlng were omitted.

workIntervalsSummary.description: Compact protected summary of work and recovery intervals. This stays complete even when detailed intervals are reduced by response-size limits.

flags.description: Detected issues or notable conditions, for example uphill, pace_drop, hr_drift, missing_hr, weak_altitude, terrain_mismatch.

sourceActivityId.description: Source activity id if available; not a route or raw payload.

userReport.description: User self-report for the workout if available.

ActivityDetailListSection.description: Limited list section. available is the full detected count; returned is how many items are included in this response.

ActivityDetailWorkIntervalSummaryItem.description: One compact workout interval summary item.

ActivityDetailItem.description: One detailed interval, lap, split, best effort, or segment item. Fields vary by section.

maxGradePct.description: Maximum grade percent for the item when available from Intervals or derived from altitude/distance streams.

redactions.description: Confirms that raw source payloads, raw streams, and route coordinates were omitted.

note.description: Generic object; actual keys may vary by workout and data source.

GoalResultEditCommand.description: One canonical command. Choose command.type only from the listed oneOf variants; aliases such as create, update, delete, add_goal, or update_goal are invalid.

oneOf.description: Canonical general_create command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical general_update command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical general_archive command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.

Canonical result_set command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical result_link_activity command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical result_detach_activity command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.

Canonical manual_result_delete command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.

Canonical legacy_result_delete command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.

noChange.description: When true, no history record exists and there is nothing to commit.
